publicReleaseNotes: On-call guidance now follows the current rota and integration screens, and Gaps this week covers the same seven-day window as its timeline, including earlier uncovered hours. Restoring an archived administrator lets the owner confirm their name and keeps access working when they sign in again. The installer guidance runs checkpoint and move-in export scripts with rer’s supplied Node runtime, and compatible integration samples are ready to paste into a terminal with a privately configured key. Agent approvals and reviews explain coordination changes using people and service names; follow-up summaries correctly say that completion requires human review by default. Incident filters, timeline entries and Readiness use readable status labels. This patch includes a security fix for the deployed product: Vite 8.2.4 addresses launch-editor vulnerabilities. The pinned rer remains 0.2.113; this update adds no migration. Back up first, keep applied migrations unchanged and keep the existing pager active: paging stays OFF.

To update from 0.3.0, back up first: locally with `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer`; for a hosted installation export its D1 database with `npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql` (the name is in `.rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json`) using the deploying Cloudflare credentials. Locally, stop `rer dev` with Ctrl-C, run `git pull --ff-only`, then `rer dev`. Hosted, from the checkout that deployed, run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT` with the same credentials; the owner, schedules and incidents are kept. The update applies ten additive migrations (0117-0126); keep all 32 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset to upgrade. Restore a backup only into an empty destination (`rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` locally, a fresh empty installation when hosted). Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. From 0.2.0, stop with `rer dev --stop` and `rer preview --stop`, then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. The update applies four additive migrations (0113–0116); keep all 22 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset to upgrade. Data, the owner and password accounts are kept. People who sign in with a workspace password sign in once more, because the held session cookie is now named `oncall_session_<port>`. Captured local sign-in mail is removed with the development outbox; open the app with the `RER_OPEN` link that `rer dev` prints. To update from 0.1.0, stop the old servers before pulling with `node scripts/rer.mjs dev --stop` and `node scripts/rer.mjs preview --stop`, install the global rer command with `curl -fsSL https://runeditrun.com/install.sh | sh` (or `npm install -g @runeditrun/rer`), then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. Back up first with `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer` (0.1.0: `node scripts/rer.mjs export --output exports/NAME.rer` while its servers are stopped). Restore only into an empty destination with `rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` after restoring the original private settings. For hosted coordination, follow Install and run → Host for your team: configure remote sign-in mail and run `rer deploy` with your Cloudflare credentials; rer claims the owner and retires the setup token. Open the app address and sign in by emailed link, or with `rer signin`. Update an existing hosted installation with `rer deploy`, preserving its owner and data. Remove with `rer deploy --remove --yes` and confirm its empty readback. Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. Independent standby and paging delivery are outside this release.
